prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE flat children’s educational illustration, crisp shapes and simple solid colors. CACE N6: CAMELL + DONAR + GLOBUS + DONA. Semantic focus: destinatari. Human appearance: recipient DONA is a adult woman aged 40. Correct age proportions. Exact scene: CAMELL lliura GLOBUS a DONA. Globus inflat lligat a un cordill curt; el donant passa el cordill a la mà oberta del receptor. Donant a l’esquerra amb gest d’oferiment; receptor a la dreta, orientat cap al donant, prenent el referent. Un sol objecte compartit en el traspàs, sense còpies ni accions paral·leles. Fons blanc sense escenari ni eina afegida. Donant antropomòrfic amable; és l’animal real del món fantàstic, no una joguina ni una persona disfressada. Pure white seamless background. WIDE SHOT, camera far away: entire people or animals INCLUDING FEET, every target object and ALL furniture legs fully in frame. Scale the complete composition small to fit the CENTRAL 65 percent of the canvas; leave a WHITE BORDER at least 12 percent wide on ALL FOUR sides. Never crop lower legs or desk legs. One action in one instant, no sequence or collage. Only essential support. Friendly school material. Absolutely NO text, letters, numerals, brands, logos, watermark, arrows or speech bubbles, including clothing and books. Humans wear ordinary clothes. Hands/paws make clear functional contact. No identifiable room or landscape. Exactly the named living participants, no spectators, no family group, no additional people or animals. Vary human skin and hair naturally: olive skin, wavy brown hair. Do not add plants, carpets or decorative accessories not required by the scene. CORRECTION REQUIRED: Camel anatomy: EXACTLY FOUR LIMBS total. Make the anthropomorphic camel stand UPRIGHT ON TWO HIND LEGS with TWO FORELEGS used as arms, one handing the balloon cord to the adult woman and the other resting at its side. Recognizable hump, long neck, camel face, tail. NO extra legs. Exactly the target living participants only. No bystanders or extra family. Include feet, full furniture legs and all objects, scale the whole composition to the central 65 percent, leave at least a 12 percent empty white border on all FOUR sides. Wide distant view, never crop.
